[Claim 1] A display control device that performs display control on a first display and a second display of a vehicle, the second display being different from the first display, the display control device comprising:
an obtainer that obtains switching information indicating that switching between driving modes including an autonomous driving mode and a manual driving mode is to be performed in
the vehicle; and
a display controller that causes, before completion of first switching, (i) the first display to display first information and third information and (ii) the second display to display second information when the switching information indicates that the
first switching is to be performed, the first switching being switching from the autonomous driving mode to the manual driving mode, the first information indicating that the first switching is to be performed, the second information being information for assisting a user of the vehicle in driving in the manual driving mode, the third information indicating that the second display is displaying the second information.
[Claim 2] The display control device according to claim 1, wherein the third information indicates a position of an area displaying the second information.
[Claim 3] The display control device according to claim 1, wherein the obtainer obtains gaze information indicating a gaze of the user, the second information includes a plurality of notices, and
when the second display is displaying the plurality of notices, the display controller identifies, according to the gaze 35 of the user indicated by the gaze information, a notice displayed
in an area at which the gaze of the user is directed and causes the second display to hide the notice identified.
[Claim 4] The display control device according to claim 1, wherein in a period until the completion of the first switching, the display controller changes a display style of at least one of the first information, the second information, or the third information from a first display style to a second display style.
[Claim 5] The display control device according to claim 1, wherein when the obtainer obtains, before the completion of the first switching, new switching information indicating that second switching is to be performed, the display controller causes, before completion of the second switching, the first display to display fourth information indicating that the second switching is to be performed, the second switching being switching from the manual driving mode to the autonomous driving mode.
[Claim 6] The display control device according to claim 1, wherein in a period until the completion of the first switching, the display controller changes a display style of at least one of the first information, the second information, or the third information from a first display style to a second display style, and when the obtainer obtains, before the completion of the first switching, new switching information indicating that second switching which is switching from the manual driving mode to the autonomous driving mode is to be performed, before completion of the second switching, the 35 display controller (i) causes the first display to display fourth information indicating that the second switching is to be performed and (ii) changes a display style of at least one of the first information, the second information, or the third information from the second display style to the first display style.
[Claim 7] The display control device according to claim 1, wherein the first display is a head-up display, and
the second display is a display mounted on a dashboard of the vehicle.
[Claim 8] A display control method for performing display control on a first display and a second display of a vehicle, the second display being different from the first display, the display control method comprising:
obtaining switching information indicating that switching between driving modes including an autonomous driving mode
and a manual driving mode is to be performed in the vehicle;
and causing, before completion of first switching, (i) the first display to display first information and third information and (ii) the second display to display second information when the
switching information indicates that the first switching is to be performed, the first switching being switching from the autonomous driving mode to the manual driving mode, the first information indicating that the first switching is to be performed, the second information being information for assisting a user of the vehicle in driving in the manual driving mode, the third information indicating that the second display is displaying the second information.
[Claim 9] A non-transitory computer-readable recording medium having stored thereon a program for causing a computer to execute the display control method according to claim 8. - 38 - - 39 - -40- - 41- 5 10 15 20 25 30 35
